items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Like Dexter used to stay at his house

ctx.x: Yeah, Leo -- see, he was on top of everybody. Like Dexter used to stay at his house, and the late Rahsaan Roland Kirk used to stay at his house also. Well, Leo was like that -- he was the type of cat who played with
quite a few of them, and was always ready for a jam session. He was a go-getter.
